result.memo: Tessellate BI - TB-Q1-TRUEUP - Q1 seat true-up

args.text:
Q1 2026 Board Deck reconciliation — US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200)

Deck figure (DOC-0207, "Q1 2026 board deck – OpEx detail (US)"): USD 11,769.00
Current GL balance for 6200, US, Q1 2026 (Jan+Feb+Mar): USD 14,569.00
  - Jan-26: 4,289.70
  - Feb-26: 4,139.80
  - Mar-26: 6,139.50 (5 Zoom card charges $149.90 = $749.50; Quire Docs JE-00229 $640.00; Tessellate BI monthly JE-00237 $1,950.00; Tessellate BI Q1 seat true-up JE-00304 $2,800.00)

Difference: $2,800.00 (14,569.00 − 11,769.00)

Root cause: The $2,800.00 difference is fully explained by one entry — JE-00304, "Tessellate BI – TB-Q1-TRUEUP – Q1 seat true-up," dated 2026-03-31, supported by vendor invoice DOC-0206 (Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP, 14 additional seats for Jan–Mar, USD 2,800.00). This entry was posted by the AP clerk on 2026-04-02 10:14, i.e. AFTER the board deck was pulled from the ledger (deck states "as of 2026-04-01 09:00"). The invoice itself is correctly dated within Q1 (2026-03-31) and properly recorded in the March 2026 period, but it landed in the GL one day after FP&A's snapshot, so it was omitted from the deck.

Verification: excluding this one entry, GL Q1 total = 14,569.00 − 2,800.00 = 11,769.00, which ties exactly to the deck figure. No other discrepancies, duplicates, or unsupported items were found in the account — all 8 postings in the quarter (Zoom card charges, Quire Docs, Tessellate BI monthly, and the true-up) have support attached.

Conclusion: The deck number was correct as of its cutoff time but is now stale due to a late AP entry (legitimate, properly dated, and supported). The correct Q1 2026 US Software Subscriptions figure, inclusive of all Q1 activity currently in the GL, is USD 14,569.00. Recommend FP&A update Appendix B of the board deck to USD 14,569.00 and add a note on the late Tessellate BI true-up. No adjusting entries are required — the GL is accurate; this is a timing/cutoff difference between the deck snapshot and the ledger, not a posting error. No journal entries were posted as part of this review.
